In detail

Avon and Somerset Constabulary recorded 311 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 15.0 per 1,000 residents, the 7th highest rate of Bristol's 34 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (24), burglary (4), vehicle crime (4); the evening/night score by violent crime (33), anti social behaviour (12), public order (8). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is St George West safe?

Wandroz currently rates St George West in Bristol as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bristol during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bristol at night. This rating is derived from Avon and Somerset Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is St George West safe at night?

At night, St George West is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bristol. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is St George West a good area to stay in as a tourist?

St George West's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bristol) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
